examples.title: What is in this .p12 and how is it protected? (no password)
Verify the MAC and list every bag

description: Describe a PKCS#12 (.p12 / .pfx) WITHOUT its password: version, the MAC construction (kind 'pbmac1' RFC 9579 with its PBKDF2 / HMAC parameters, or 'pkcs12-kdf' — the RFC 7292 Appendix B MAC pkinative never verifies; null when the file has none), every SafeContents with its encryption scheme (PBES2 parameters, or the name of a legacy RC2 / 3DES scheme pkinative refuses), and the bags of the unencrypted SafeContents. With `password` (or PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD): `macVerified` (true / false — a wrong password or an altered file is a REPORT, not an error; null without a MAC) and `opened`: every SafeContents opened, each bag as an allow-list view — a certBag by subject / issuer / serial, a keyBag or pkcs8ShroudedKeyBag by its algorithm, curve and encryption parameters, a crlBag by size. No result ever carries a key byte, a bag value or the password, not even from an unencrypted keyBag. Refusals: a wrong password on an ENCRYPTED SafeContents is PKI_CRYPTO_DECRYPTION_FAILED; a legacy MAC PKI_KEY_MAC_UNSUPPORTED and a legacy cipher PKI_KEY_ENCRYPTION_UNSUPPORTED (only when a password asks for them), each with the OpenSSL 3.4 conversion remedy; a public-key integrity-mode file PKI_KEY_MAC_UNSUPPORTED at parse. Nothing is imported here: open_pkcs12 is the one-call verdict with non-extractable key import. limits.maxPkcs12Bags and maxPkcs12KdfIterations bound the file's declared cost. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary' (macKind, macVerified, contentCount, bagCount, bagKinds).

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

password.description: The password of an encrypted PKCS#8 key or a PKCS#12 file (UTF-8). Never echoed, logged or cached. Alternatively set PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD in the server environment and omit this input (never both) — the variable keeps the secret out of the model transcript.

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

pkcs12.description: The PKCS#12 file (.p12 / .pfx; DER, or BER with encodingRules:'ber' for a Windows-written PFX): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

name: inspect_pkcs12

outputSchema.description: PKCS#12 description (allow-list views, never a key byte). Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

bagCount.description: Bags listed: those of `opened` when a password was given, else those of the plain SafeContents.

contents.description: The AuthenticatedSafe entries, in encoded order.

bags.description: The bags of a plain SafeContents; empty for an encrypted one until opened.

certificate.description: A certBag: subject, issuer, serial — or { unreadable: true, bytes } when it does not parse.

key.description: A private key described without any secret byte: a plain PKCS#8 key (format pkcs8) or an encrypted one (format encrypted-pkcs8).

kind.description: keyBag, pkcs8ShroudedKeyBag, certBag, crlBag, secretBag, safeContentsBag or unknown.

localKeyId.description: Hex; what ties a key to its certificate.

encryption.description: The password scheme of an encrypted SafeContents (pbes2 present when PBES2); null for a plain one.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

mac.description: The MacData, or null when the file carries none (its integrity cannot be verified).

kind.description: 'pbmac1' (RFC 9579, verifiable) or 'pkcs12-kdf' (RFC 7292 Appendix B, never verified by pkinative).

macVerified.description: With password: true when the PBMAC1 MAC matches, false for a wrong password or an altered file (a report, not an error); null when the file has no MAC.

opened.description: With password: every SafeContents opened (the encrypted ones decrypted), its bags as allow-list views.

certificate.description: A certBag: subject, issuer, serial — or { unreadable: true, bytes } when it does not parse.

key.description: A private key described without any secret byte: a plain PKCS#8 key (format pkcs8) or an encrypted one (format encrypted-pkcs8).

kind.description: keyBag, pkcs8ShroudedKeyBag, certBag, crlBag, secretBag, safeContentsBag or unknown.

localKeyId.description: Hex; what ties a key to its certificate.

title: Inspect PKCS#12 (MAC kind, SafeContents, bags; optional MAC check and opening, no key byte)
